description: Every token that traded in the last day, from LoomDesk's own index of every swap on the chain: price, market cap, 24h volume, fees, trades, depth, age, tier (established / new / untested) and keep (the share of its fees the busiest pool kept after the price moved). Flagged tokens (a stranger cannot sell them, or they tax transfers) are left out. `query` searches by symbol, name or address. `leadersWindowSeconds` instead returns the most traded and highest volume tokens over that window (300 to 604800).
name: market_tokens
title: What trades on Robinhood Chain
